verdicts.reason: InvoiceList is a verbatim copy of the buggy OrderList pattern: useEffect is passed only a callback with no dependency array, and the effect calls api.get("/invoices").then(setInvoices), which sets state on every completion. Each state update triggers a re-render, which re-runs the effect, causing an infinite refetch loop. Nothing guards the fetch (no ref, no condition, no early return) and no caller handles it. The same fix applies exactly: add `[]` as the second argument so the fetch runs once on mount.
